BackgroundTaskCue.description:
A background job of the profile changed: read it again if the revision
is newer than the one read last.

job_id.description: The job, where the family has one per record.

revision.description: The job's stored revision, which rises with every change to it.

BackgroundTaskFamily.description:
The kinds of background job the window is cued about: a closed list,
which another background operation joins by adding its family.

job_id.description: The job, where the family has one per record.

BackgroundTaskRevisions.description:
The background jobs of the signed-in profile, each at its stored
revision, as one read found them.

x-cadrumo-port.description: The host's cues and the jobs' stored revisions for the signed-in profile.

methods.description: Calls `listener` with each cue the host sends, until the returned function unsubscribes. A change before subscribing is not cued: read the revisions after it.
Every background job's stored revision, read now.

x-cadrumo-port.name: BackgroundTasksPort
